text: Goddess Lakshmi is not just about wealth.
The food we eat, our health, knowledge, courage, peace in our home, happiness in our family, and contentment of mind – all these are forms of Sri (Lakshmi).
That's why Shravana Shukravaram puja is not just about asking, "Mother, please give us more wealth."
It is about recognizing the blessings we have already received and welcoming the Goddess with gratitude.
Being able to find happiness in that wealth is an even greater form of Lakshmi.
Let us pray that our homes be filled with wealth, happiness, health, peace, and contentment.
